punchline: AT&T gave ground and kept the lock.
thirty_sec: On 19 December 1913 AT&T promised the Attorney General it would give up its Western Union stake and connect independents to its long-distance lines, but local service and its equipment arm were left alone.
question: Which clause in your current deal sits next to the concession and goes unmentioned?
key_contrast: What was given was the visible complaint; what was kept was the system itself.
